name: SB 204070
summary: SB-204070 is a drug which acts as a potent and selective 5-HT4 serotonin receptor antagonist (or weak partial agonist), and is used for research into the function of this receptor subtype.

pharmacology.text: SB-204070 is a drug which acts as a potent and selective 5-HT4 serotonin receptor antagonist (or weak partial agonist), and is used for research into the function of this receptor subtype.

uses.text: SB-204070 is a drug which acts as a potent and selective 5-HT4 serotonin receptor antagonist (or weak partial agonist), and is used for research into the function of this receptor subtype.

fact.en: Its SB code marks it as a compound from SmithKline Beecham. The 5-HT4 receptor it blocks sits mostly in the gut, where it controls how food is moved along.
fact.zh: 它的 SB 代號表示這是 SmithKline Beecham 公司的化合物。它所阻斷的 5-HT4 受體主要位於腸道，負責調控食物的推進。
fact.zhHans: 它的 SB 代号表示这是 SmithKline Beecham 公司的化合物。它所阻断的 5-HT4 受体主要位于肠道，负责调控食物的推进。
